summary: Verified Tradera search merge, header UI changes, compact status, sticky tabs, https image normalization, and watch flow for Tradera items. All 5 backend pytest tests pass and all frontend scenarios work as specified.

issues: Observed one Mixed Content console warning for http://img.tradera.net/images/210/662391210_...jpg being auto-upgraded by the browser. Backend API test for image fields (image/image_url) found 0 http:// URLs, so the http URL is likely in a secondary field (e.g. thumbnail/picture) not covered by the normalize path. Non-blocking because browser auto-upgrades, but should normalize to https in backend for cleanliness.

action_items: Optional: in crawler._upsert / tradera.search, normalize ALL image-like fields (thumbnail/picture/image_url variants) from http:// to https:// to remove the single remaining Mixed Content console warning observed on www.tradera.com images.
critical_code_review_comments: crawler._upsert normalizes http->https for primary image field, but Tradera parser may emit additional image fields. Consider centralized https upgrade on all URL fields.
/api/live/auctions path excludes Tradera when q is missing - good. 120s per-q throttle via _tradera_seen is sensible but ensure cache key is case-insensitive and trimmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 5/5 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_tradera_search.py pass (no-q excludes Tradera, q=festool returns many Tradera items mixed with others, fixed_price+auction mix, https image check, watch POST works). Frontend verified @1920x1080 and 390x844: add-auction-button is gone; view-toggle sits top-right (box x=1237 w=331 at desktop), sticky on scroll on both viewports; compact crawler-status-text + 8 source-status chips visible; searching 'festool' renders 120 watch-live-* cards including pink Tradera badges; clicking Bevaka on a Tradera card shows toast 'Bevakar "Maskinpaket Festool"' and counter went 5->6 without reload; Mina bevakningar grid shows the newly watched Tradera items. One mixed-content console warning observed from a tradera.net image URL - browser auto-upgrades; minor.
